name: Robot to Playwright migration
description: Ports one old-CRM Robot folder (or chosen files of it) to the ase-crm Playwright suite: the analyst inventories it and plans, a person approves the plan and answers questions, the analyst writes verified scenario sheets, the spec writer implements, runs and commits the specs on the run branch, then after a notification a person approves delivering it: merged into branch workflow/main of the workflow's own copy of the suite, ~/repos/ase-crm-testPlaywright-workflow (deliver=local) or pushed to GitHub (deliver=github). Reject = cancel, nothing delivered. Start each run with the prompt "Port <robotFolder>". Local mode never touches the main checkout ~/repos/ase-crm-testPlaywright; the copy is merged into it by hand once reviewed (diff workflow-baseline..workflow/main).

parameters.name: projectDir
parameters.description: The suite repo that run worktrees are made beside. Local mode: the workflow's own copy, ~/repos/ase-crm-testPlaywright-workflow (branch workflow/main). VM: the suite clone.

parameters.name: robotFolder
parameters.description: Robot folder or suite file to port, relative to robotSuiteDir, e.g. Alepo_Testsuites/Business_Configuration/Policies/Taxes.

parameters.name: include
parameters.description: Only these suite files of robotFolder, comma separated (e.g. 01__Bank_Defination.robot). Blank = the whole folder.

parameters.name: exclude
parameters.description: Suite files to leave out, comma separated (e.g. Billing_Policy_API_Creation.txt). Blank for none.

parameters.name: robotSuiteDir
parameters.description: Checkout of the old Robot suite (atddtestsuite_bss), the source of truth.

parameters.name: crmSourceDir
parameters.description: Checkout of the new CRM source (frontend + backend), read to work out navigation, fields and messages.

parameters.name: crmStack
parameters.description: Per-session stack name for docker/stacks/stack.sh test-env (db|ui). Overrides appUrl/keycloakUrl/dbHost and sets the stack lock. Blank = use those three.

parameters.name: deliver
parameters.description: local = merge the run branch into workflow/main of localCheckout (the copy; nothing pushed); github = push the run branch.

parameters.name: runCheckout
parameters.description: in-place = every run works in projectDir itself, on its own branch fix/run-<id> cut from baseBranch, so there is one folder for all runs. worktree = a separate <projectDir>@fix-run-<id> folder per run.

parameters.name: baseBranch
parameters.description: Local branch of projectDir that each run's branch is cut from and that Deliver (local) merges into.

parameters.name: localCheckout
parameters.description: The workflow's own copy of the suite (same repo as projectDir in local mode). deliver=local merges into its workflow/main; also the node_modules source for run worktrees.
